target_host.description: Target host address or CIDR range (IPv4 only).

threshold.description: Number of packets to inject when not in flood mode.

protocol.description: Protocol to inject (e.g., tcp, udp, icmp, t50).

source_addr.description: Source IP address for packets. Use 'random' for automatic generation.

bogus_csum.description: Use bogus random checksums instead of calculating real ones.

turbo.description: Enable turbo mode using a child process for higher speed.

shuffle.description: Shuffle protocol selection when protocol is set to 't50'.
